angles.rationale: The intake's moment is a quiet week and its message is the pause the reader keeps putting off; the occasion frame lets the two Seeds of pieces follow the lift (voice contract section 4, rule 1). The Seeds of Calm Necklace in Aquamarine leads.

The product frame opens on the pieces themselves, aquamarine and phosphosiderite, with their meaning said as tradition (route_axes axis_notes.product; intake.guidance.notes). A spotlight opens on the necklace's display name from the intake.

The intake carries an offer as tokens ({{discount_value}}, {{discount_code}}, {{offer_window}}), which the urgency frame can lead with while the figures stay merge tokens (route_axes axis_notes.urgency). An offer module opens, calm in tone.
